title: bus.dependabot.alerts v1
description: Emitted by the ci-watch adapter's dependabot pass (adapters/ci-watch/) on a severity-count TRANSITION (any of critical/high/moderate/low changes from the previously observed count, or first-seen) for a watched GitHub repo's open Dependabot alerts (`gh api /repos/<owner>/<repo>/dependabot/alerts?state=open`). Never emitted per-poll for an unchanged count. Feeds the estate board's per-project 'signals.dependabot' field (adapters/board/board.py) via a joined machine-readable file, not directly.

repo.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository (e.g. warxhead1/hearth-loom)

prev.description: Severity counts recorded on the previous poll, or null if this is the first time ci-watch observed this repo's alerts

new_critical_ghsa_ids.description: GHSA advisory ids newly seen at severity 'critical' this poll (not present in the persisted known-critical set) -- these are what trigger an auto-filed triage bead, one per id, deduped by repo+advisory across polls

reason.description: Why this event fired: a real severity-count change, or the first successful poll of this repo's alerts
